## Linked task and changes

Use an English Conventional Commit PR title, for example `docs: clarify adapter authentication`.

## Validation

Commands actually run and their results; omitted tests and reasons:

## Constraint checklist

- [ ] No daemon, background keep-alive, gateway, or project backend was introduced.
- [ ] CLI/App/MCP preserve common semantics without upper-layer brand branches.
- [ ] No credentials, live identifiers, or sensitive logs enter the commit.
- [ ] Unknown/accepted outcomes are not mislabeled verified; retries are safe.
- [ ] Documents, diagrams, schemas, examples, and compatibility records are synchronized.
- [ ] Mock tests are not presented as physical-device verification.
- [ ] Documentation, comments, PR text, and commit messages are English.
- [ ] Commit subjects and the PR title use approved Conventional Commit types.
